te: US Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Gilfoyle asked to resign
de: The US administration has demanded that Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Gilfoyle resign amid the scandal and accusations against her. This was announced by the press Secretary of the White house Kathy Zacharias at the first briefing in his new position.

t: Белый дом сообщил о раскрытии мошеннических схем на $260 млрд в США
d: Власти США обнаружили мошеннические схемы на сумму более 260 миллиардов долларов с момента возвращения Дональда Трампа на пост президента. Об этом заявила пресс-секретарь Белого дома Кэти Закария на брифинге в Вашингтоне.
te: White House reveals $260 billion in fraudulent schemes in US
de: U.S. authorities have uncovered fraudulent schemes worth more than $260 billion since Donald Trump returned to the presidency. This was stated by the press Secretary of the White house Kathy Zakaria at a briefing in Washington.

te: Batrakov scored the first “batragol” for “Galatasaray”
de: Footballer Alexei Batrakov opened the scoring in the match of Galatasaray with Barcelona in the Champions League. By the 34th minute, the hosts led 2-0 after the goals of the Russian midfielder and Barysh Alper Yilmaz.

te: Batrakov became the first Russian author of the goal in the Champions League since December 2021
de: Alexey Batrakov broke a five-year pause without goals of Russian players in the Champions League. The midfielder of the Turkish “Galatasaray” struck the goal of the Spanish “Barcelona” in the 28th minute of the match of the general stage.

te: Air defense destroyed 30 UAVs AFU on approach to Moscow on October 13
de: Air defense crews intercepted and destroyed 30 Ukrainian drones flying to Moscow. This was reported by the capital mayor Sergei Sobyanin.
